explanation: One conversation needs ${327{,}680 \times 4{,}096 = 1.342}$ GB, and ${160 / 1.342 = 119.2}$, so 119. Most conversations are shorter than the limit, and a paged KV cache only allocates blocks that are used, so in practice the server runs more sequences and **preempts** (pauses or recomputes) one if memory runs out.
